levels.title: Concentration & Form Recognition
levels.description: Recognize the critical differences between concentrated and dilute formulation names.
levels.learningObjective: Identify safety risks when standard drug names share identical chemical roots but differing concentrations.

questions.prompt: Which product is dangerously confused with glacial acetic acid when concentration is overlooked?
questions.explanation: Glacial acetic acid is concentrated and corrosive. Inadvertent substitution for dilute acetic acid for irrigation has caused severe tissue burns.

levels.title: Release Mechanism Discrimination
levels.description: Differentiate modified-release suffixes and distinct dosage delivery kinetics.
levels.learningObjective: Distinguish immediate-release from extended-release formulations to prevent overdosage.

questions.prompt: Adderall is commonly confused with Adderall XR when release mechanisms are overlooked. What is the primary clinical difference?
choices: Adderall is immediate-release while Adderall XR is extended-release
Adderall is an antibiotic while Adderall XR is an antifungal
Adderall is an intravenous infusion while Adderall XR is a topical cream
They are manufactured by different companies but are chemically identical
questions.correctAnswer: Adderall is immediate-release while Adderall XR is extended-release
questions.explanation: Adderall (immediate-release) and Adderall XR (extended-release) have different dosing frequencies and pharmacokinetics. Inadvertent substitution can lead to adverse toxicity or subtherapeutic treatment.
